tools.name: run
tools.description: HTML to clean Markdown for LLM and RAG pipelines: headings, lists, tables, links, code fences. Priced per call, no expiring credits and no separate extraction plan.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "run" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
